thumbnail.alt: The demo's front page: Dashi's header with Home, Articles and Recipes links, the heading "Super easy vegetarian pasta bake", three linked recipe and article titles, and a band of four recipe cards with photos (Borscht with pork ribs, Fiery chili sauce, Crema catalana and Thai green curry). The footer reads "Served by decoupled-drupal-mock from a recording of Drupal CMS's Dashi site template. No Drupal is running."
